scenario_results.observed: SupportIntegrationTest: a customer opens QUALITY and FOOD_SAFETY cases on an own order (another customer's order 404; CANCELLATION_REQUEST category and short descriptions 422); the customer view has no severity, SLA or assignee. The staff queue (support.case; customer and order.ops 403) lists the FOOD_SAFETY case first as CRITICAL with escalatedAt set. A STAFF_ONLY note does not count as first response; a PUBLIC reply does and moves the case to IN_PROGRESS. The customer sees 2 messages without the note; staff see 3; another customer and the cook get 404. Messages are append-only and customer-authored staff notes are rejected by the database. Browser workflow: the FOOD_SAFETY case appears as critical in the operations support queue; an internal note added in the UI is absent from the customer's case. Mutations exposing notes or dropping ownership failed tests.

SupportIntegrationTest: a cancellation request on a pending order is 409; after acceptance another customer gets 404, an unknown reason 422, the request opens a HIGH CANCELLATION_REQUEST case, a second request 409, and the order version and state are unchanged; the customer view offers REQUEST_CANCELLATION and lists the case id. Resolving as ORDER_CANCELLED before cancellation is 409. order.ops lists the order under OPEN_CASE and the view shows flags, case ids and active-order contact without handover code (support.case 403, unknown flag 422). After preparation an audited exception cancellation with the case reference cancels it; the case is then resolved; the order timeline shows CANCELLED and order events are append-only. Resolution needs code and reason, CLOSE only after RESOLVED, closed cases refuse messages, overdue cases are flagged and filterable, updates are audited. Browser workflow: the same request/flag/exception-cancel/resolve path through the operations web. Handover override with step-up: OrderLifecycleIntegrationTest (backend verify) and the UI step-up prompt.

findings: Privacy and ownership rules enforced in service and database; three mutations detected.
Cross-module access through ports only (OrderDirectory, OrderCases).
Proposed defaults: categories, severity, SLA 30 min/2 h/24 h, resolution codes.
Residual: no case attachments; no staff paging on SLA breach (O07); cooks have no case access.
